relevant_experience.title: iOS Developer

ezeep Blue for iOS (2020 – 2023): rewrote it from scratch in SwiftUI with one other developer. 300k downloads since release, 15k still installed in 2026.

Cortado MDM for Android (since 2025): migrated nearly every screen to Jetpack Compose; in 2026 grew the suite from 1,040 to 5,308 tests and branch coverage from 14% to 83%, and cut summed test runtime from a July peak of 37.7 to 5.2 minutes.
Earlier products (2018 – 2023): Workplace and Teamplace iOS clients, incl. Objective-C to Swift and RxSwift to Combine migrations; an unreleased UIKit app with offline sync; NFCReader, sole author.

Across products: CI/CD, signing and releases for iOS and Android (GitLab CI, Fastlane, SBOM, TestFlight, staged rollout); security scans, code and security reviews; Android Enterprise Partner Program certification; agentic development since 2025; mentoring two developers in agentic workflows.
